name: OWASP Top 10 for Business Logic Abuse
source_notes: IDs and names verified from tab_top10.md in the OWASP www-project-top-10-for-business-logic-abuse repo; Incubator badge from the project page.
caveats: Names follow the current repo; a 2025-06-04 press release (secondary, PR Newswire) used different names such as "Data Oracle Exposure" and "Sequential State Bypass". Names may still change.
Released is the edition year; the only exact date (2025-06-04) comes from that secondary press release.
Project led by Ivan Novikov (Wallarm); vendor-led origin.
Summaries are short paraphrases of the repo descriptions; prevention was not captured.
detection.static entries and related links are reinhardt inferences.

items.name: Action Limit Overrun
items.summary: Actions that should be limited (e.g. per user or per transaction) can be performed more times than intended.

review: Business-logic flaw; requires workflow review or runtime testing

items.name: Concurrent Workflow Order Bypass
items.summary: Concurrency or out-of-order requests bypass the intended workflow sequence.

review: Business-logic flaw; requires workflow review or runtime testing

items.name: Object State Manipulations
items.summary: Unfiltered client input is bound into server objects (mass assignment), changing state the user should not control.

static: Request bodies spread into ORM create/update: Model.create(req.body), update(..., req.body), {...req.body}, prisma.x.update({data: req.body}), supabase.from(t).insert(req.body)

items.name: Malicious Logic Loop
items.summary: Logic can be driven into loops or non-terminating processing.

review: Business-logic flaw; requires workflow review or runtime testing

items.name: Artifact Lifetime Exploitation
items.summary: Tokens, sessions or temporary files remain valid beyond their intended lifetime.

static: JWTs/sessions/signed URLs with no expiry or very long expiresIn/maxAge

items.name: Missing Transition Validation
items.summary: State transitions are not validated, so objects move into states they should not reach.

review: Business-logic flaw; requires workflow review or runtime testing

items.name: Resource Quota Violation
items.summary: Missing rate limits or quotas let users consume resources beyond intended limits.

static: No rate-limit middleware on auth, AI or other expensive endpoints

items.name: Internal State Disclosure
items.summary: Different responses for valid versus invalid input reveal internal state (e.g. user enumeration).

static: Distinct login/reset errors for unknown user vs wrong password

items.name: Broken Access Control
items.summary: Business functions are reachable without proper role or permission checks.

review: Business-logic flaw; requires workflow review or runtime testing

items.name: Shadow Function Abuse
items.summary: Hidden internal, debug or test endpoints remain reachable in production.

static: Routes like /debug, /test or /admin without auth middleware
